doc.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010

title: Steering interviews
summary: She steers conversations toward what she is promoting.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: So have you ever done an interview and you’re sitting there and you’re saying gee I wish they would ask me this?

Well I just steer the conversation if there’s something I want to talk about. Sometimes you have to. Like if you’re promoting a certain project. If the interview has a purpose, you know, if it’s promoting a certain thing and the conversation isn’t getting there. Sometimes you have to — “Well we do have a show tonight at 8 p.m. at this place.” You know, this kind of thing.
